passage.label: O believed let not wealth children divert remembrance Allah whoever does losers; spend way Allah provided before death approaches says Lord delay brief term give charity among righteous; never Allah delay soul time come Allah Acquainted what do

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُلۡهِكُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
وَأَنفِقُواْ مِن مَّا رَزَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوۡلَآ أَخَّرۡتَنِيٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ قَرِيبٖ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهَاۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ

mainSubject.label: Believers warned not to let wealth or children divert them from Allah's remembrance, with whoever does so named among the losers; spending urged from divine provision before death arrives prompting the plea for a brief delay to give charity and join the righteous; the impossibility of delay affirmed once a soul's appointed time arrives, under His acquaintance with all deeds

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of Allah.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: وَأَنفِقُواْ مِن مَّا رَزَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوۡلَآ أَخَّرۡتَنِيٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ قَرِيبٖ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Spend from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you.

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the propped-timber paranoia and enemy identification (4) before the forgiveness-refusal block opens (5); P2 ends with the honour-attribution correction (8) before the believer-address begins (9); P3 covers the wealth-children warning, the pre-death spending urge and the closing no-delay affirmation (9-11).
